title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1989-07-19
lineage: Master Cassettes (Maxell MX 100) Tascam 112MKII -> Korg MR-1, 1bit 2.8MHz -> USB -> Korg Audio Gate Software 24bit 96KHz -> Wave Lab 6.0 w/UAD -> R8brain for 16bit 44.1KHz sample rate conversion -> Traders Little Helper flac8 -> Tagged w/Tag & Rename
source: Nakamichi CM-300's CP-1 caps worn in a hat stealth-style -> Sony WM-D6C. ("Third night we were in the pavilion FOB")

ai_review.summary: A solid Alpine show captured on a good‑but‑tinny recording, highlighted by Phil’s memorable Box of Rain.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers gave the set four stars, noting that the performance was energetic enough to keep fans dancing in the rain and that Phil’s surprise Box of Rain was a standout moment. The audio is described as “very good” though a bit tinny, indicating a generally clear capture with some high‑frequency harshness. Overall the show feels like a key point for the reviewer’s return to Dead concerts.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive 4‑star reviews; solid musical performance with a memorable song, recording is good though slightly tinny, yielding an overall strong but not exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very good overall but a bit tinny; clear enough to enjoy the show despite some high‑frequency harshness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic performance that kept fans engaged despite rainy, camping‑field conditions; the band let it rock for their intrepid audience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Thanked by reviewer, indicating a positive impression of his presence.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned for bringing out Box of Rain, highlighting his contribution to the show’s memorable moment.
